name: trafficbud
description: Audit web pages for search-engine and AI-assistant visibility, check sitemaps, mobile layout and spelling, and generate structured data.

interface.longDescription:
TrafficBud is an SEO analysis tool. It checks web pages the way search engines and AI assistants read them, scores them, and explains what to fix.

Ask about any public page and TrafficBud returns a score from 0 to 100 with a list of concrete issues in order of severity, each with a fix: titles, meta descriptions, headings, canonical tags, indexability, internal links, image alt text, structured data, Open Graph tags, viewport and load time.

It can also check a site's XML sitemap and robots.txt, look for mobile layout problems, find spelling mistakes in a page's visible text, and write paste-ready JSON-LD structured data for a page. Accounts with Google Search Console connected can review weekly ranking history and the queries and pages closest to earning more clicks, and look up Google Keyword Planner search volumes.

TrafficBud never changes your website. It reads public pages and your connected data and reports back, and saves each audit and check to your TrafficBud account so you can open the full report later.
defaultPrompt: Audit my homepage for SEO problems and tell me what to fix first.
Check whether my sitemap and robots.txt are set up correctly.
Write FAQ structured data for my pricing page.

positive.description: General SEO audit of one page
positive.prompt: Audit https://www.trafficbud.io/ for SEO problems and tell me what to fix first.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a 0-100 score and a severity-ranked list of issues with a fix for each, plus a link to the saved report on trafficbud.io.

positive.prompt: Check whether the sitemap and robots.txt for trafficbud.io are set up correctly.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the sitemap address, reports a score, how many URLs are listed and checked, and any problems such as missing lastmod dates.

positive.prompt: Is https://www.trafficbud.io/mcp-server mobile-friendly? Check it with TrafficBud.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a mobile score and verdict, listing any viewport, tap-target, font-size, fixed-width or keyboard-hint problems.

positive.prompt: Write FAQPage structured data for https://www.trafficbud.io/mcp-server.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns paste-ready FAQPage JSON-LD built from the questions on the page, with placement notes and any warnings.

positive.prompt: Use TrafficBud to find monthly search volumes for keywords related to "seo audit tool".
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a table of related keywords with average monthly Google searches and competition level from Google Keyword Planner.

negative.description: Unrelated request: no TrafficBud tool should be called
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Boston today?

negative.description: Request to edit a website: TrafficBud is read-only on websites, so no tool should be called and the assistant should explain it cannot make changes
negative.prompt: Change the title tag on my homepage to "Best SEO tool".

negative.description: Private network address: audit_page must refuse to fetch it

publication.release_notes: First release: SEO and AI-visibility audits, sitemap, mobile, spelling and structured-data checks, keyword volumes and Search Console insights for a signed-in TrafficBud account.
